findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] I1891/I1895 canonical pattern present: all lookups use SQLAlchemy ORM bound expressions - db.query(User).filter(User.username == username) (:49-51), User.id == user_id (:54-56), User.phone_number == phone_number (:82-84) - so values travel as parameters rather than SQL text. update_user (:184-209) assigns only the UPDATABLE_PROFILE_FIELDS frozenset instead of vars(user), which is also an allow-list over what may reach the persistence layer. No raw SQL, text() or execute() with interpolated input in this file | verdict=pass confidence=high
